funding-D-judgments.judgment_policy: Same final audited targets and fieldsets as A/B. First inspect structured outputs, then verify sources. New reliable pre-cutoff evidence can correct all arms; unresolved latest-event cases remain null symmetrically. No provider traces used for initial judgments.

reference_corrections.score_effect: A/B funding_stage and citation_support become false for missing later event; announcement_date null symmetrically for A/B/C; C funding_stage/citation_support true; entity_resolution true in all arms. No amount target added.

reference_integrity.policy: Frozen input/reference file not modified. Final audited corrections applied equally across all arms.

lifecycle-D-judgments.adjudication_method: Manual assessment of structured outputs before inspecting retrieval traces. Arm labels are visible; this is not blinded. Sources checked independently.
